title: Inti jalsu Punku uñjiri
intro: Quran taqpach taypinx yaqhip almanakax aka uraqinx yatiñan ukhamarak muspharkañ thakhinak jaytasaw sarnaqapxi. Ukham uñachtʼäwinakat maynïrejj luratanakan wali jaya cheqanakaruw saräna, mä arunjja, intejj mistu ukat jalantki uka cheqanakaruw saräna, ukanjja mä jarkʼasaw jan waltʼäwinak jarkʼaqaraki. Aka Allah luqtirirux mä reino churapxäna, ukax janiw khitis mayamps utjkaniti. Kimsa mayj mayj saräwinakampiw aka jaqin amtapax qhanstawayxi. ¿Aka legendario sarnaqir jaqirux sarnaqäwin ch’iwinakap taypit uñt’asmati?
clues: Khuyaptʼayasiri Diosaw aka Oraqe apnaqañatak chʼamañchtʼitäna, kunjamtï jan khitis lurawayki ukhama.
Inti jalant tuqir puriñkamaw inti jalant tuqir sarawayta, ukat mä chʼamaktʼat uma jalsun jalantkir jikxatta, ukat ukanwa mä markar uñjta.
Inti jalsu tuqiruw sarawaytxa, kawkhantï intix jalsuski uka chiqar puriñkama, ukat mä markaruw mistunir jikxatta, jupanakatakix janiw uka markat imantasiñ churapkti.
Uka pä sinti jachʼa cheqanak taypinwa sarnaqayäta, pä qollunak taypinkir mä valleruw puriyäta, ukanjja mä jaqeruw jikjjatta, jupanakajj janiw arunak sum amuyapkänti.

Qullunjja, hierrot lurat pä chʼama barreranak jikjjatta, ukajj chʼeqa toqeru ukat chʼeqa toqeruw puri, ukat uka taypinjja mä jiskʼa thakïnwa. Uka jaqinakax jan walt’awinak jark’aqasax barrera p’akintañatakiw mayipxitäna.

Nayajj manqʼa aptʼasisaw akham sista: ‘Kunapachatï uka jarkʼajj pʼakjasini ukhajja, aka markampejj qhan tʼaqanuqtañäniwa’ sasa. Ukat horasajj purinkäna ukhajja, qhepat barrerajj pʼakjatäjjäna uk uñjayäta.

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Yajuj ukat Majuj markachirinakatakix hierro barrera p’akjaña
Wila quta iyawsiri jaqinakampi chika makhataña
Mä chiqapa markar arxatañatakix mä represa luraña
trial.answer: Yajuj ukat Majuj markachirinakatakix hierro barrera p’akjaña

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Pä qullu taypin hierrot lurat jark’aqasiña
Jerusalén markan Diosar yupaychañ qullan uta
location.answer: Pä qullu taypin hierrot lurat jark’aqasiña

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Uka jarkʼajj horasajj purinkäna ukhajj pʼakjatäjjänwa, ukat jan waltʼäwinakaw utjäna
Jan iyawsirinakax umamp chhaqhayatäpxänwa, iyawsirinakax qhispiyatäpxänwa
Mä jachʼa thayampiw uka markajj tʼunjatäjjäna
outcome.answer: Uka jarkʼajj horasajj purinkäna ukhajj pʼakjatäjjänwa, ukat jan waltʼäwinakaw utjäna

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
